title: Walmart Multi-Zip Monitor dataset record
description: One validated or explicitly failed product-by-ZIP observation from Walmart Multi-Zip Monitor.

combinationId.title: Combination ID
combinationId.description: Stable identifier for this product-by-ZIP combination.

inputRef.title: Input reference
inputRef.description: Customer-provided reference, or the Walmart item ID when no reference was supplied.

zipCodeRequested.title: Requested ZIP
zipCodeRequested.description: U.S. ZIP code requested in the input.

zipCodeResolved.title: Resolved ZIP
zipCodeResolved.description: ZIP code returned for Walmart's selected store context, or null when location validation failed.

locationApplied.title: Location applied
locationApplied.description: True only when the response was verified against the selected Walmart store context.

storeId.title: Store ID
storeId.description: Verified Walmart store ID used for the observation.

storeDistanceMiles.title: Store distance
storeDistanceMiles.description: Walmart-reported distance from the requested ZIP to the selected store, in miles.

reasonCode.title: Reason code
reasonCode.description: Machine-readable primary reason when status is not success.

reasonCodes.title: Reason codes
reasonCodes.description: All machine-readable validation or failure reasons for the row.

failureStage.title: Failure stage
failureStage.description: Pipeline stage that produced a non-success result.

message.title: Message
message.description: Concise diagnostic message with secrets and request headers excluded.

title.title: Product title
title.description: Product title returned by Walmart for a validated observation.

price.title: Current price
price.description: Current selected-offer price. Crossed-out and unit prices are not used.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Walmart.com's selected-store digital availability signal; not a physical shelf guarantee.

sellerName.title: Seller name
sellerName.description: Seller displayed for the selected offer.

offerScope.title: Offer scope
offerScope.description: Whether the selected price is locally fulfillable or shipping-only.

fulfillment.title: Fulfillment
fulfillment.description: Shipping, pickup, and delivery signals for the selected offer and store context.

previous.title: Previous observation
previous.description: Last successfully delivered observation for this monitor, item, and ZIP.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Typed differences from previous to current observation.

isFirstObservation.title: First observation
isFirstObservation.description: True when no prior successful observation exists for this monitor, item, and ZIP.

latencyMs.title: Latency
latencyMs.description: Product-fetch latency measured by the runtime, in milliseconds.
